model: First magnetic path-length feedback with a separate mean-throat response

parameters.separation_convention: Fixed once so the prior single-delay1.2 corresponds to the shortest leading path in its old leading clock; not a measured or solved physical separation

equations.normalization: Delta_*w=-rho*jhat_phi; delta_nu=lambda*w, lambda=8pi²*alpha. Unit tangent in jhat_phi=-(t cross curvature)_phi/(12Lbar²).

far_limit.scope: Formal continuum-channel far limit of the flat point-pair free-space response, not a finite-q completed exterior. Stream negativity gives this exterior shape contribution only. deltaLbar/Lbar grows as lambda/nu, so linearization is not uniform at nu=0; finite-q localization also fails there. First frequency-moment response remains integrable, but an unweighted mean deltaLbar does not. Throat, interface and metric feedback are not supplied.

mean_closure.scope: Only the existing radial mean collar adjusts. The nonspherical metric, interface and finite-q state do not. Fprime is a static closure-map derivative; its magnitude is not a dynamical stability criterion. This is a linear correction, not a completed nonlinear solution.

equations.stream: Delta_*w=-rho*jhat_phi; delta nu=lambda*w, lambda=8*pi²*alpha. w=rho/pi integral jhat*V*H(m)/sqrt(D) dnu ds.
equations.length: deltaLbar/lambda=integral w*[3u(1+s²)(u²-s²)²/(4root*C^(3/2))] ds; point-mouth endpoint work vanishes.
equations.state: delta omega_nu²=-2omega_nu²*deltaLbar/Lbar at fixed common clock and collar.
equations.mean: delta w=delta F_magnetic/[1-Fprime(w)]; delta omega_nu²_total=delta omega_nu²_magnetic+(partial_w omega_nu²)*delta w.

scope: Formal leading static flat-source Green response and its first path/state correction; same continuum channel assumptions as73. The longest-channel perturbation is nonuniform: deltaL/L~−0.00798909*lambda/nu. Finite-q channels near nu*q~1 require a different quantum description. Unknown actual-minus-modeled currents, curved-region and nonspherical metric/clock response, physical boundaries, formation and dynamics remain. No stable medium or backward travel is established.
sources: https://arxiv.org/html/1807.04726v3: magnetic-channel model and its finite-q limit.
https://arxiv.org/html/2510.11663v1: azimuthal Green representation; our noncompact source needs the separately checked convergent limit.
https://dlmf.nist.gov/19.2: elliptic-integral definitions. Path feedback, tail and conditional mean update are our calculations.
